encoding_notes: Guide 'Revised on February 2019'; live page clean-fetched via WebFetch and full text confirmed via headless render (Apify).
ISSN not stated in the guide -> null (no fabrication from memory).
Font: only '12-point' stated, no typeface named -> font.family null.
Original-article and case-report length caps given in 'type-written pages' (10 and 5 pages), not word counts -> manuscript_max_words null; figures_max derived from 'sheets of figures' (15, 8).
Running title max = 10 words (guide states words, not chars) -> running_title_max_chars null.
line_numbers / page_numbers / alignment / first_line_indent unstated -> conservative defaults (none/false/null).

Blinding: review not stated as double-blind; guide item 7 requires no mention of the institution in the body (esp. Abstract/Methods) -> scrub_body_identifiers true; title page carries authors so separate_title_page true.
Figure DPI is tiered: 300 dpi for photos, 1200 dpi for line art; min_dpi=300 (schema holds one value).
Figure file formats not enumerated in guide (only 'MS Word or RTF' for main document) -> formats [].
Funding is disclosed within the Acknowledgments section (not a standalone funding section); it also appears on the title page if relevant.
Reviews and editorials are invited/requested, not open author submissions; letters are accepted but no format or limits are prescribed (omitted from sections/word_limits).

Data sharing statement required for clinical-trial reports (ICMJE, since 1 Jul 2018); ethics/IRB stated in Methods; patient image consent via JBM Authorization and Release Form -> conditional declarations, not placed in the fixed end sequence.
Manuscript title case not prescribed; table and figure titles use sentence case ('only the first letter of the first word ... capital').
Reference style: numbered/bracket in cited order, MEDLINE journal abbreviations, DOIs shown in every journal-article example; other types follow NLM 'Citing Medicine' -> style nlm.
